name: spatial_place_relational
description: Relational spatial placement engine. Snaps and positions an actor relative to scene anchors using CAD constraint solving, collision bounding, and style dials.

anchor_actor.description: Reference actor name or label in level (e.g. 'Corridor_DoorL', 'Floor_0', 'Chandelier')

socket_name.description: Optional specific mesh socket to snap to

local_offset.description: Optional local [X, Y, Z] offset relative to anchor bounds

actor_label.description: Optional custom outliner label for the spawned instance
